title: Lunar AeroLabs Shares New LAGF800 Development Screenshots and Cockpit Tour for MSFS 2024
summary: Lunar AeroLabs has shared another development update on its upcoming LAGF800 ultra-long-range business jet for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, showcasing a fresh collection of exterior screenshots and highlighting continued progress on the aircraft's flight dynamics and handling characteristics.
body:
![](/assets/image1.png)

The latest update, posted on the developer's official Discord channel, provides another look at the LAGF800 as it continues through alpha development. The newly released screenshots showcase the aircraft from several angles, including atmospheric sunset and nighttime scenes, offering a closer look at the exterior modelling, distinctive winglets, fuselage detailing and overall visual presentation.

According to Lunar AeroLabs, development is progressing steadily, with the team continuing to refine both the aircraft's visual appearance and its planned features. However, the developer emphasised that considerable attention is also being given to the flight model and handling characteristics, which remain among its highest priorities.

While the latest images demonstrate the visual progress being made, Lunar AeroLabs has reiterated that the aircraft remains a work in progress and that the screenshots do not necessarily represent the final product.

![](/assets/image2.png)

![](/assets/image3.png)

![](/assets/image4.png)

### LAGF800 Cockpit Tour

Alongside the latest exterior previews, Lunar AeroLabs has also released a cockpit tour video, giving flight simulation enthusiasts an opportunity to take a closer look at the flight deck of its upcoming ultra-long-range business jet.

The video offers an additional preview of the aircraft as development continues towards a future release for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

### Growing Community Support

Lunar AeroLabs also took the opportunity to celebrate two community milestones, announcing that its official Discord server has surpassed **800 members**, while its Instagram account has attracted more than **600 followers**.

The developer thanked its growing community of aviation enthusiasts, real-world pilots, fellow developers and flight simulation fans for their continued interest, feedback and support throughout the project.

What began as an ambitious concept for a modern ultra-long-range business jet is steadily developing into a highly anticipated addition to the MSFS 2024 business aviation scene.

### What Comes Next?

Although Lunar AeroLabs has not provided a confirmed release date in this update, the latest screenshots and ongoing work on the flight model suggest that development continues to move forward.

With further improvements to the aircraft's systems, visuals and flight characteristics underway, the LAGF800 remains an interesting project for business aviation enthusiasts to keep an eye on.

We'll continue to follow the LAGF800's development and share further news as Lunar AeroLabs releases additional information.

*Source: Lunar AeroLabs Official Discord Channel and YouTube.*
